bav.faq_q1: Where do I find my player ID?
bav.faq_a1: Open the game, go to Settings, then User Settings from the left menu — your player ID is at the bottom. Tap the copy icon to make sure it's saved correctly with no mistakes.
bav.faq_q2: Do you need my account password?
bav.faq_a2: No. Top-ups only need your player ID — we never ask for a password or any login details.
bav.faq_a3: The exact fulfillment time for each product is shown on its own page, and you'll get a confirmation message once it's done. We're online :hours.
bav.faq_q4: What if I enter the wrong ID?
bav.faq_a4: Your order is processed on exactly the ID you enter, which is why we ask you to confirm it before paying. Double-check it before you complete your order.
bav.faq_a5: Yes. We only use your player ID to add the top-up — we never ask for a password, login details, or verification codes. Don't share it with anyone, not even with us.
bav.faq_a6: No. Digital files cannot be refunded once delivered.

bav.about_lead: Bav Store is your trusted destination for digital services, where speed meets clarity. We make in-game currency top-ups effortless, alongside a range of ready digital files and guides built around what you actually need. We believe trust is built in the details: a clear price you see before you pay, simple steps that take no time at all, and a turnaround time we commit to and state upfront.
bav.about_commit1_desc: We show you the full price before you pay, tax included, with no hidden fees added later. You also get the chance to carefully review your order details before confirming it.
bav.about_commit2_desc: We commit to fast fulfillment after payment is confirmed — the exact turnaround time for each product is clearly stated on its own page. Once it's done, you'll get an instant confirmation message.
bav.about_commit3_desc: Your privacy and security come first. All we ever need is your player ID - no password, no login details, no verification codes. Your account stays entirely in your own hands.
bav.about_commit4_desc: We don't disappear once your order is placed. Our team is ready to answer your questions during working hours, :hours.
